description: Defines an abstract class EntityDisplayModeBase for managing configuration of entity display modes (form/view) in Drupal, including properties, sorting, dependency calculation, and URL routing.

classes.name: EntityDisplayModeBase
classes.description: Abstract class for entity display mode configuration, providing properties and methods for managing display modes in Drupal.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts display mode entities by target type, then by parent sort.

methods.name: getTargetType
methods.description: Returns the target entity type for the display mode.

methods.name: setTargetType
methods.description: Sets the target entity type for the display mode.

methods.name: calculateDependencies
methods.description: Calculates dependencies based on the target entity type.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Pre-save hook to clear cached field definitions.

methods.name: preDelete
methods.description: Pre-delete hook to clear cached field definitions.

methods.name: urlRouteParameters
methods.description: Provides URL route parameters, including entity type for add-form.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the display mode.
